title: Jacob's 3D Ladder with Flowers (Pink)
description: Replaces vanilla ladders with realistic 3D models decorated exclusively with delicate pink flowers. Bring a sweet and aesthetic spring vibe to your builds! (1.14+)
body:
![2K Banner](https://i.imgur.com/c38zURI.png) --- ![Explanation-Banner](https://i.imgur.com/1b5b4PR.png) Want to add a sweet, natural, and aesthetic touch to your Minecraft world? **Jacob's 3D Ladder with Flowers (Pink)** completely revamps the ordinary ladders in the game, bringing a delicate spring atmosphere to your builds! It is the perfect add-on for players who love nature-themed structures. --- ### 🌟 Highlights * **Realistic 3D Model:** Forget the classic, flat, and paper-like vanilla ladder textures. This texture pack adds depth to the ladders, giving them a much more realistic and stylish 3D appearance. * **Delicate Pink Flowers:** Make climbing much more enjoyable and aesthetic! The fresh **pink flowers** delicately placed on the ladders bring a sweet, cherry-blossom vibe to your designs. * **Wide Version Support:** No need to worry about being stuck on older versions! This pack is designed to work seamlessly and is fully compatible with **Minecraft 1.14 and all newer versions**. --- ### 🛠️ Installation 1. Copy the downloaded `.zip` file into the `%appdata%\.minecraft\resourcepacks` folder on your computer. 2. Launch the game and open the **Options > Resource Packs** menu. 3. Find **Jacob's-3D-Ladder-with-Flowers-(Pink)-1.14+** in the list, move it to the active packs side, and click "Done". > **Note:** Add this pack to your world right away to bring a sweet, natural, and spring-like atmosphere to your builds. Happy crafting! --- ### 🌸 Choose Your Variant! Looking for a specific color? I've separated the flowers into different packs so you can choose the exact vibe that fits your build's color palette: * [**🌺 Mixed Flowers (Pink & Yellow)**](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/jacobs-3d-ladder-with-flowers) - The original colorful mix! 📍 **(You are here)** * [**🌸 Pink Flowers Only**](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/jacobs-3d-ladder-with-flowers-pink) - For a delicate, sweet, and spring-like vibe. * [**🌼 Yellow Flowers Only**](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/jacobs-3d-ladder-with-flowers-yellow) - For a bright, warm, and sunny atmosphere. --- [**My Other Projects**](https://modrinth.com/user/JacobStar_) --- ![Compatibility](https://i.imgur.com/tORJuey.png) ![1](https://i.imgur.com/3Gf3yi1.png) ![1](https://i.imgur.com/Suadni5.png) ![1](https://i.imgur.com/Oyo76x3.png) --- ![Credits & Thanks-Banner](https://i.imgur.com/7U9MoxE.png) - **Vanilla 3D Ladders** – fully created by me. - And of course, thanks to the Minecraft community for the feedback and support! --- ## Features * Lightweight, no performance loss. * You can use my texture pack in your video if you want. 😊 ---
